declarations.description: Form-associated image picker web component with preview UI, externally managed uploads, optional downloader, placeholder and overlay slots, and CSS customization.
declarations.name: JBImageInputWebComponent

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name returned by the name property.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Placeholder title text and accessible aria label.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Helper text shown in the placeholder message area and exposed as aria description.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Enables required validation. A string value is used as the required validation message.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: When set to true, the hidden native file input accepts multiple files and image-selected exposes the full FileList. The component still previews and uploads the first selected file.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Native file accept string forwarded to the hidden file input.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables file selection and overlay actions, and sets disabled accessibility/custom state.

attributes.name: is-uploading
attributes.description: Shows externally managed upload loading state.

members.name: value
members.description: Canonical component value and native form value. Selecting an image sets this to the File. Use File, string, FormData, or null when this value must be submitted by a native form. Setting another value calls downloader or automatically loads a string URL.

members.name: file
members.description: Currently selected local File, or null when empty.

members.name: imageBase64Value
members.description: Base64/data URL preview image after a local file is read or downloader resolves.

members.name: accept
members.description: Native file accept string forwarded to the hidden file input.

members.name: maxFileSize
members.description: Maximum accepted file size in bytes. Oversized files fail validation and dispatch max-size-exceed.

members.name: downloader
members.description: Optional function that converts a stored value into a preview image data URL.

members.name: uploadPercent
members.description: Externally managed upload progress percentage.

members.name: isUploading
members.description: Whether externally managed upload loading is shown.

members.name: isLoading
members.description: Computed aggregate loading state.

members.name: config
members.description: Developer-defined configuration object passed to downloader.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Controls whether the hidden native file input has the multiple attribute.

members.name: required
members.description: Enables required validation.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables file selection and overlay actions, and sets disabled accessibility/custom state.

members.name: status
members.description: Read-only visual state: empty, uploading, uploaded, or downloaded.

members.name: form
members.description: Associated form from ElementInternals.

members.name: selectedImageType
members.description: MIME type of the currently selected local file, or undefined before a file is selected.

members.name: validation
members.description: jb-validation helper. Set validation.list for custom validation rules that receive { file, value }.

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: Current native validation message from ElementInternals.

members.name: initialValue
members.description: Default and reset value. It initializes value until the live value is explicitly set.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: True when current value differs from initialValue.

members.name: name
members.description: Current name attribute value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restores initialValue and clears displayed validation.

methods.name: openImageSelector
methods.description: Opens the hidden native file picker.

methods.name: selectImageByFile
methods.description: Injects a File as if the user selected it, validates it, previews it, and dispatches change when valid.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation without showing the error message and dispatches invalid when invalid.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Runs validation, shows the first error message, and dispatches invalid when invalid.

methods.name: ExtractBase64ImageFromFile
methods.description: Static helper that reads a File and resolves its data URL.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when a file is selected or the selected image is deleted.

events.name: download-start
events.description: Cancelable event dispatched before a stored value is converted into a preview.

events.name: image-selected
events.description: Dispatched after the hidden native file input changes. event.detail.files contains the selected FileList.

events.name: max-size-exceed
events.description: Dispatched when the selected file is larger than maxFileSize. event.detail.file contains the oversized File.

events.name: invalid
events.description: Dispatched when checkValidity or reportValidity finds an invalid value.

slots.name: placeholder
slots.description: Custom content shown while the component status is empty.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Replaces the full image overlay shown over the preview image.

slots.name: overlay-content
slots.description: Replaces the default overlay controls while keeping the default overlay container.

cssParts.name: message
cssParts.description: The helper or validation message element inside the default placeholder.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: Applied when the disabled property is true.
